headline: Argentine Agricultural Machinery Maker Metalfor Files for Preventive Bankruptcy
summary: Metalfor, an agricultural machinery manufacturer based in Marcos Juárez, filed for preventive bankruptcy following months of financial crisis and layoffs.
why: Corporate distress among major agricultural suppliers reflects tightening credit conditions and economic challenges within Argentina's industrial and farming sectors.

impacts.name: Metalfor
impacts.why: Filing for preventive bankruptcy indicates severe financial distress and operational restructuring.
